description: LLM-ready briefing on a French company (SIREN), returned as Markdown text to read or paste as is: identity without officers, filed accounts over three years with their reliability, BODACC insolvency notices, commercial-court decisions and public contracts counted and dated, each block with its status, age and coverage. Written by code from official registers, no model text; legal entities only (a sole proprietorship answers 400, never charged). The text opens with its instruction and ends with its source line: copy it verbatim. Paid via x402 ($0.05 in USDC or EURC).

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) to pay with prepaid credits instead of x402, with no wallet needed. Get one at https://api.sirenic.eu/compte?utm_source=api&utm_campaign=mcp. Ignored when x_payment is provided (the signed payment wins). On insufficient balance the tool returns a credits error, not an x402 quote.

langue.description: fr or en; default: the API key account's language, else fr

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive the payment quote.

name: get_french_company_briefing
title: French company briefing for an AI
